modules.title: Half-plane surface in `Space 3`
modules.doc:
The half-plane in `Space 3` with its measure, distribution and vanishing ambient volume.

## i. Overview

The half-plane is the coordinate plane in `Space 3` with nonnegative second
coordinate. It is the image of the domain `halfPlaneDomain` in `Space 2` under the coordinate
plane embedding `halfPlane`. Pushing forward the restricted volume gives the measure
`halfPlaneMeasure`, and integrating against it gives the distribution `halfPlaneDist`. The
half-plane lies in a proper linear subspace, so it has ambient volume zero.

## ii. Key results

- `halfPlaneDomain` : the domain of the half-plane inside `Space 2`.
- `halfPlane` : the coordinate plane embedding of `Space 2` into `Space 3`.
- `halfPlaneMeasure` : the measure corresponding to integration over the half-plane.
- `halfPlaneDist` : the distribution corresponding to integration over the half-plane.
- `volume_halfPlane_image_domain` : the half-plane has ambient volume zero.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The definition of the half-plane surface
- B. The measure associated with the half-plane
- C. The distribution associated with the half-plane
- D. The half-plane has ambient volume zero

modules.title: Line surfaces in `Space d`
modules.doc:
The coordinate line in `Space d` with its measure, distribution and vanishing ambient volume.

## i. Overview

The line surface is the coordinate line in `Space d`, the image of `ℝ` under the embedding
`line d`. Pushing forward the volume on `ℝ` gives the measure `lineMeasure d`, and integrating
against it gives the distribution `lineDist d`, roughly the integral of a test function against a
density concentrated on a line. For `2 ≤ d` the line lies in a proper linear subspace, so it has
ambient volume zero.

## ii. Key results

- `line` : the coordinate line embedded in `Space d`.
- `lineMeasure` : the measure corresponding to integration along the line.
- `lineDist` : the distribution corresponding to integration along the line.
- `lineSubmodule` : the linear subspace spanned by the line.
- `volume_line_range` : for `2 ≤ d` the line has ambient volume zero.

## iii. Table of contents

modules.title: Ring surface in `Space 3`
modules.doc:
The unit ring in `Space 3` with its measure and the distribution of integration around it.

## i. Overview

The ring surface is the unit circle `S¹` of `Space 2`, embedded into `Space 3` by `ring`. Pushing
forward the measure on the sphere gives the finite measure `ringMeasure`, of total mass `2π`, and
integrating against it gives the distribution `ringDist`. The file also gives integrability
criteria for continuous functions and the invariance of `ringMeasure.prod volume` under a shear.

## ii. Key results

- `ring` : the embedding of the unit circle into `Space 3`.
- `ringMeasure` : the measure corresponding to integration around the ring.
- `ringMeasure_univ` : the total mass of the ring measure is `2π`.
- `integrable_ringMeasure_of_continuous` : continuous functions on the ring are integrable.
- `ringDist` : the distribution corresponding to integration around the ring.
- `ringDist_eq_integral_delta` : `ringDist` as an integral of Dirac deltas over the ring.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The definition of the ring surface
- B. The measure associated with the ring
- C. The distribution associated with the ring

modules.title: Solid cylinder surface in `Space 3`
modules.doc:
The solid unit cylinder in `Space 3` with its measure, distribution and positive volume.

## i. Overview

The solid cylinder is the closed unit disk in `Space 2` extruded along the third coordinate.
It is the solid analogue of the spherical cylinder, in the same way that the solid sphere is the
solid analogue of the spherical shell. Like the solid sphere it is a region of positive ambient
volume, so the measure associated with it is built from the ambient volume of the cross-sectional
disk (the solid-sphere measure in `Space 2`) extruded along the axis, rather than a pushforward of
a lower-dimensional surface measure. The measure-zero requirement is therefore not applicable here
and is replaced by a statement that the solid cylinder has positive ambient volume.

## ii. Key results

- `solidCylinder` : the embedding of a cross-sectional disk extruded along the axis.
- `solidCylinderMeasure` : the measure corresponding to integration over the solid cylinder.
- `solidCylinderDist` : the distribution corresponding to integration over the solid cylinder.
- `solidCylinderMeasure_univ_pos` : the solid cylinder has positive measure.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The definition of the solid cylinder surface
- B. The measure associated with the solid cylinder
- C. The distribution associated with the solid cylinder
- D. The solid cylinder has positive ambient volume

- `solidSphereMeasure` : the measure corresponding to integration over the solid sphere.
- `solidSphereDist` : the distribution corresponding to integration over the solid sphere.
- `solidSphere_volume_pos`, `solidSphereMeasure_univ_pos` : the solid sphere has positive volume.

modules.title: Star, derivatives, truncation and the Euler operator on the jet ring
modules.doc:
The further structure the jet ring of spacetime carries, beyond its ring structure.

## i. Overview

`Physlib.SpaceAndTime.SpaceTime.SpaceTimeAlgebra.Basic` carries `SpaceTimeAlgebra`, the ring of
formal power series in the spacetime coordinates, which is the ring of jets of a field at a
point. Four further pieces of structure on it are developed here, each needed to state a
Lagrangian as an element of a jet algebra.

The star operation is coefficientwise complex conjugation, fixing the formal variables: the
spacetime coordinates are self-adjoint. It makes the jet ring a `StarRing` and a `StarModule`
over both `ℝ` and `ℂ`, and `starConjEquiv` identifies the conjugate module of the jet ring with
the jet ring itself, honestly `ℂ`-linearly, since the conjugate-linearity of `star` cancels
against the twisted scalar action. That is what identifies the jets of a conjugate field with
the conjugates of the jets.

The formal partial derivative commutes with the star, and the iterated derivative
`iteratedPDeriv` is additive, homogeneous and satisfies a Leibniz rule over the antidiagonal of
the multiset of directions; `constantCoeff_iteratedPDeriv_mul` is the form a component
computation uses.

The truncation `truncation n` sets the Taylor coefficients of total degree above `n` to zero.

Finally the Euler operator `∑ x^ρ ∂_ρ` detects jets: a jet with vanishing constant coefficient
killed by the Euler operator is zero, and `coeff_eq_zero_of_coeff_pderiv_eq_zero` is the graded
form of that statement, where control of the first derivatives below degree `n` controls the
coefficients up to degree `n`.

## ii. Key results

- `SpaceTimeAlgebra.coeff_star`, `SpaceTimeAlgebra.star_X` : the star is coefficientwise, and
  the coordinates are self-adjoint.
- `SpaceTimeAlgebra.starConjEquiv` : the conjugate module of the jet ring is the jet ring.
- `SpaceTimeAlgebra.pderiv_star`, `SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv_mul` : the derivative
  commutes with the star, and the Leibniz rule for iterated derivatives.
- `SpaceTimeAlgebra.truncation` : the truncation of a jet.
- `SpaceTimeAlgebra.eq_zero_of_sum_X_smul_pderiv_eq_zero` : the Euler operator detects jets.
- `SpaceTimeAlgebra.coeff_eq_zero_of_coeff_pderiv_eq_zero` : its graded form.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The star structure on the jet ring
- B. The formal partial derivative
- C. Truncation of jets
- D. The Euler operator
  - D.1. The Euler vanishing principle by degree

## iv. References

The jet ring itself is in `Physlib.SpaceAndTime.SpaceTime.SpaceTimeAlgebra.Basic`.

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.starConjEquiv
declarations.doc:
**The real structure of the jet ring.** Coefficientwise conjugation is a `ℂ`-linear
equivalence from the conjugate module of the jet ring back to the jet ring itself. It is
honestly `ℂ`-linear, not merely semilinear, because the conjugate-linearity of `star`
cancels against the twisted scalar action of `ConjModule`.

This is what identifies the jets of a conjugate field with the conjugates of the jets:
`ConjModule (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)` and `SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] ConjModule V` differ
exactly by this equivalence on the jet-ring factor.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def starConjEquiv : ConjModule SpaceTimeAlgebra ≃ₗ[ℂ] SpaceTimeAlgebra

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.starConjEquiv_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma starConjEquiv_apply (f : ConjModule SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    starConjEquiv f = star ((conjEquiv (k := ℂ) (M := SpaceTimeAlgebra)).symm f)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.starConjEquiv_symm_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma starConjEquiv_symm_apply (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    starConjEquiv.symm f = conjEquiv (k := ℂ) (M := SpaceTimeAlgebra) (star f)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.coeff_single_one_mul
declarations.doc:
The first-order Leibniz rule: the degree-one Taylor coefficient, in the
direction `μ`, of a product of jets. This is the coefficient-level statement
that the first jet of a product is given by the product rule.
declarations.statement:
lemma coeff_single_one_mul (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (f g : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    coeff (Finsupp.single μ 1) (f * g) =
      coeff (Finsupp.single μ 1) f * constantCoeff g +
        constantCoeff f * coeff (Finsupp.single μ 1) g

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.constantCoeffₗ
declarations.doc: The constant-coefficient evaluation of a jet, as a `ℂ`-linear map.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def constantCoeffₗ : SpaceTimeAlgebra →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.constantCoeffₗ_apply
declarations.statement: lemma constantCoeffₗ_apply (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) : constantCoeffₗ f = constantCoeff f

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv_pderiv
declarations.doc: Iterated formal derivatives commute with a single formal partial derivative.
declarations.statement:
lemma iteratedPDeriv_pderiv (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    iteratedPDeriv s (pderiv μ f) = pderiv μ (iteratedPDeriv s f)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv_smul
declarations.doc: Iterated formal derivatives preserve complex scalar multiplication.
declarations.statement:
lemma iteratedPDeriv_smul (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (c : ℂ)
    (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    iteratedPDeriv s (c • f) = c • iteratedPDeriv s f

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv_neg
declarations.doc: Iterated formal derivatives commute with negation.
declarations.statement:
lemma iteratedPDeriv_neg (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    iteratedPDeriv s (-f) = -iteratedPDeriv s f

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv_zero_apply
declarations.doc: The iterated formal derivative of the zero jet vanishes.
declarations.statement:
lemma iteratedPDeriv_zero_apply (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    iteratedPDeriv s (0 : SpaceTimeAlgebra) = 0

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv_sum
declarations.doc: The iterated formal derivative of a finite sum.
declarations.statement:
lemma iteratedPDeriv_sum {κ : Type*} (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (t : Finset κ)
    (f : κ → SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    iteratedPDeriv s (∑ k ∈ t, f k)
      = ∑ k ∈ t, iteratedPDeriv s (f k)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv_C_of_ne_zero
declarations.doc:
The iterated derivative of a constant jet vanishes for a nonempty multiset of
directions.
declarations.statement:
lemma iteratedPDeriv_C_of_ne_zero {s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)} (hs : s ≠ 0) (c : ℂ) :
    iteratedPDeriv s (C c : SpaceTimeAlgebra) = 0

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.truncation
declarations.doc:
The `n`-th truncation of a jet: the Taylor coefficients of total degree
greater than `n` are set to zero.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def truncation (n : ℕ) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) : SpaceTimeAlgebra

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.coeff_truncation_of_le
SpaceTimeAlgebra.coeff_truncation_of_gt
SpaceTimeAlgebra.truncation_add
declarations.statement:
lemma truncation_add (n : ℕ) (f g : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    truncation n (f + g) = truncation n f + truncation n g

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.truncation_zero
declarations.statement: lemma truncation_zero (n : ℕ) : truncation n (0 : SpaceTimeAlgebra) = 0

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.truncation_one
declarations.doc:
Truncation fixes the identity: a constant series has its only nonzero Taylor
coefficient in degree zero, which every truncation keeps.
declarations.statement: lemma truncation_one (n : ℕ) : truncation n (1 : SpaceTimeAlgebra) = 1

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.truncation_eq_one_of_coeff
declarations.doc:
A power series with value `1` and no coefficients in nonzero degree up to `n`
truncates to `1`.
declarations.statement:
lemma truncation_eq_one_of_coeff {n : ℕ} {f : SpaceTimeAlgebra} (h0 : constantCoeff f = 1)
    (hf : ∀ p : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ, p ≠ 0 → Finsupp.degree p ≤ n → coeff p f = 0) :
    SpaceTimeAlgebra.truncation n f = SpaceTimeAlgebra.truncation n (1 : SpaceTimeAlgebra)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.coeff_X_smul
declarations.doc:
The Taylor coefficients of a jet multiplied by a formal coordinate: the
coefficient shifts down by one in that direction.
declarations.statement:
lemma coeff_X_smul (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (p : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff p ((X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • f) =
      if Finsupp.single ρ 1 ≤ p then coeff (p - Finsupp.single ρ 1) f else 0

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.coeff_sum_X_smul_pderiv
declarations.doc:
The Euler (radial) operator acts on Taylor coefficients as multiplication by the
total degree.
declarations.statement:
lemma coeff_sum_X_smul_pderiv (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (p : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff p (∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • pderiv ρ f) =
      ((Finsupp.degree p : ℕ) : ℂ) * coeff p f

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.eq_zero_of_sum_X_smul_pderiv_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
The scalar vanishing principle for the Euler operator: a jet vanishing at the base
point that is killed by the Euler operator is zero.
declarations.statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_sum_X_smul_pderiv_eq_zero {f : SpaceTimeAlgebra} (h0 : constantCoeff f = 0)
    (hf : ∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • pderiv ρ f = 0) : f = 0

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.coeff_mul_eq_zero_of_lt
declarations.doc:
A product with a factor whose coefficients vanish below degree `n` has coefficients
vanishing below degree `n`.

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.coeff_eq_zero_of_coeff_pderiv_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
The Euler vanishing principle: a power series all of whose first derivatives have
coefficients vanishing below degree `n` has vanishing coefficients in every nonzero degree
up to `n`, since `∑_ρ x_ρ ∂_ρ f` has the coefficient of `f` at `p` scaled by the degree
of `p`.
declarations.statement:
lemma coeff_eq_zero_of_coeff_pderiv_eq_zero {n : ℕ} {f : SpaceTimeAlgebra}
    (hf : ∀ (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (q : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ), Finsupp.degree q < n →
      coeff q (pderiv ρ f) = 0)
    {p : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) (hpn : Finsupp.degree p ≤ n) : coeff p f = 0

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.coeff_eq_zero_of_pderiv_eq_mul
declarations.doc:
A power series satisfying a radial relation `∂_ρ f = x_ρ f`, with the `x_ρ` vanishing
below degree `n`, has no coefficients in nonzero degree up to `n`.

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.C_real_smul
declarations.statement:
lemma C_real_smul (r : ℝ) (x : ℂ) :
    (MvPowerSeries.C (r • x) : SpaceTimeAlgebra) = r • MvPowerSeries.C x

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.constantCoeff_real_smul
declarations.doc: The constant coefficient commutes with real scalars.
declarations.statement:
lemma constantCoeff_real_smul (r : ℝ) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (r • f) = r • MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff f

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.pderiv_real_smul
declarations.doc: The formal derivatives commute with real scalars.
declarations.statement:
lemma pderiv_real_smul (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (r : ℝ) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    MvPowerSeries.pderiv μ (r • f) = r • MvPowerSeries.pderiv μ f

modules.title: Jacobi's formula for matrices of jets
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

Jacobi's formula `∂ det M = tr (∂M · adj M)` for a square matrix of jets, in the generality
needed by the jets of any special unitary group: it is what makes the Maurer–Cartan form
`i (∂U) U⁻¹` of an `SU(n)` jet traceless, since `det U = 1` and `U⁻¹ = adj U`.

## ii. Key results

- `SpaceTimeAlgebra.pderiv_finset_prod` : the Leibniz rule for a finite product.
- `SpaceTimeAlgebra.jacobi` : Jacobi's formula.

## iii. Table of contents

- B. Jacobi's formula

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.pderiv_finset_prod
declarations.doc: The Leibniz rule for a finite product.
declarations.statement:
lemma pderiv_finset_prod {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Finset ι)
    (f : ι → SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    pderiv μ (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, (∏ j ∈ s.erase i, f j) * pderiv μ (f i)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.jacobi
declarations.doc:
**Jacobi's formula**: the derivative of a determinant is the trace of the derivative
against the adjugate.
declarations.statement:
lemma jacobi {κ : Type} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (M : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra)
    (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    pderiv μ M.det = (M.map (pderiv μ) * M.adjugate).trace

modules.title: Matrices over the jet ring
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

Results about matrices with entries in `SpaceTimeAlgebra`, chiefly the Euler (radial) transport: a
matrix of jets vanishing at the base point is the radial logarithmic derivative of a formal
fundamental solution.

## ii. Key results

- `mapMatrix_constantCoeff_star` : entrywise evaluation at the base point commutes with the
  conjugate transpose
- `coeff_sum_X_smul_map_pderiv` : the Euler operator on matrices of jets acts entrywise on Taylor
  coefficients as multiplication by the total degree
- `matrix_eq_zero_of_euler_eq_mul_add_mul` : the vanishing principle for the Euler operator: a
  matrix of jets vanishing at the base point and satisfying `E W = A W + W B` with `A`, `B`
  vanishing at the base point is zero
- `exists_matrix_eulerTransport` : the Euler (radial) transport of a jet matrix `R` vanishing at the
  base point: a fundamental solution of the radial system `E U = R U` based at the identity, built
  order-by-order by the Euler recursion

## iii. Table of contents

- B. The Euler vanishing principle by degree on matrices

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.mapMatrix_constantCoeff_star
declarations.doc: Entrywise evaluation at the base point commutes with the conjugate transpose.
declarations.statement:
lemma mapMatrix_constantCoeff_star {n : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* ℂ).mapMatrix (star A) =
      star ((constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* ℂ).mapMatrix A)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.coeff_sum_X_smul_map_pderiv
declarations.doc:
The Euler operator on matrices of jets acts entrywise on Taylor coefficients as
multiplication by the total degree.
declarations.statement:
lemma coeff_sum_X_smul_map_pderiv {κ : Type}
    (M : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra) (p : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ) (i j : κ) :
    coeff p ((∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • M.map (pderiv ρ)) i j) =
      ((Finsupp.degree p : ℕ) : ℂ) * coeff p (M i j)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.matrix_eq_zero_of_euler_eq_mul_add_mul
declarations.doc:
The vanishing principle for the Euler operator: a matrix of jets vanishing at the
base point and satisfying `E W = A W + W B` with `A`, `B` vanishing at the base point
is zero. Each Taylor coefficient of `W` is a multiple of coefficients of strictly
smaller degree, so all vanish by strong induction on the degree.
declarations.statement:
lemma matrix_eq_zero_of_euler_eq_mul_add_mul {κ : Type} [Fintype κ]
    {W : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra} (A B : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra)
    (hA : ∀ i j, constantCoeff (A i j) = 0) (hB : ∀ i j, constantCoeff (B i j) = 0)
    (h0 : ∀ i j, constantCoeff (W i j) = 0)
    (hW : ∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • W.map (pderiv ρ) = A * W + W * B) :
    W = 0

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.exists_matrix_eulerTransport
declarations.doc:
The Euler (radial) transport of a jet matrix `R` vanishing at the base point:
a fundamental solution of the radial system `E U = R U` based at the identity,
built order-by-order by the Euler recursion.
declarations.statement:
lemma exists_matrix_eulerTransport {κ : Type} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (R : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra) (hR0 : ∀ i j, constantCoeff (R i j) = 0) :
    ∃ U : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra, (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* ℂ).mapMatrix U = 1 ∧
      ∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • U.map (pderiv ρ) = R * U

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.coeff_entry_eq_zero_of_map_pderiv_eq_mul
declarations.doc:
The matrix form of `coeff_eq_zero_of_pderiv_eq_mul`: the entries of a matrix of power
series satisfying `∂_ρ A = X_ρ A`, with the `X_ρ` vanishing below degree `n`, have no
coefficients in nonzero degree up to `n`.
declarations.statement:
lemma coeff_entry_eq_zero_of_map_pderiv_eq_mul {κ : Type} [Fintype κ] {n : ℕ}
    {A : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra} {X : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra}
    (hd : ∀ ρ, A.map (pderiv ρ) = X ρ * A)
    (hX : ∀ (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (q : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ), Finsupp.degree q < n →
      ∀ i j, coeff q (X ρ i j) = 0)
    (i j : κ) {p : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) (hpn : Finsupp.degree p ≤ n) :
    coeff p (A i j) = 0

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.matrix_map_truncation_eq_one
declarations.doc:
A matrix of power series with identity value and no coefficients in nonzero degree up
to `n` truncates to the identity.
declarations.statement:
lemma matrix_map_truncation_eq_one {κ : Type} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] {n : ℕ}
    {A : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra}
        (h0 : (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* ℂ).mapMatrix A = 1)
    (hA : ∀ (i j : κ) (p : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ), p ≠ 0 → Finsupp.degree p ≤ n →
      coeff p (A i j) = 0) :
    A.map (SpaceTimeAlgebra.truncation n) = (1 : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra).map
        (SpaceTimeAlgebra.truncation n)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.matrix_map_pderiv_mul
declarations.doc: The entrywise Leibniz rule for matrix products of jets.
declarations.statement:
lemma matrix_map_pderiv_mul {κ : Type} [Fintype κ] (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (M N : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    (M * N).map (pderiv ρ) = M.map (pderiv ρ) * N + M * N.map (pderiv ρ)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.sum_X_smul_map_pderiv_mul
declarations.doc: The Euler operator on matrices of jets is a derivation.
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_X_smul_map_pderiv_mul {κ : Type} [Fintype κ]
    (M N : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    ∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • (M * N).map (pderiv ρ) =
      (∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • M.map (pderiv ρ)) * N +
        M * ∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • N.map (pderiv ρ)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.sum_X_smul_map_pderiv_star
declarations.doc: The Euler operator commutes with the conjugate transpose.
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_X_smul_map_pderiv_star {κ : Type}
    (M : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    ∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • (star M).map (pderiv ρ) =
      star (∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • M.map (pderiv ρ))

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.sum_X_smul_map_pderiv_one
declarations.doc: The Euler operator kills the identity matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_X_smul_map_pderiv_one {κ : Type} [DecidableEq κ] :
    ∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • (1 : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra).map (pderiv ρ) = 0

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.eulerTransport_mul_star
declarations.doc:
A fundamental solution of the radial system `E U = R U` based at the identity is
unitary when `R` is anti-hermitian: `U U† − 1` vanishes at the base point and
satisfies a homogeneous linear radial system, so it vanishes identically.
declarations.statement:
lemma eulerTransport_mul_star {κ : Type} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    {R U : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra} (hRstar : star R = -R)
    (hR0 : ∀ i j, constantCoeff (R i j) = 0)
    (hU0 : (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* ℂ).mapMatrix U = 1)
    (hEU : ∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • U.map (pderiv ρ) = R * U) :
    U * star U = 1

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.sum_X_smul_mcMatrix_of_eulerTransport
declarations.doc:
The radial Maurer–Cartan component of a unitary fundamental solution of the radial
system `E V = −i P V` is `P`: `∑_μ x_μ · i (∂_μ V) V† = P`.
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_X_smul_mcMatrix_of_eulerTransport {κ : Type} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    {P V : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra} (hVu : V * star V = 1)
    (hEV : ∑ μ, (X μ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • V.map (pderiv μ) = ((-Complex.I) • P) * V) :
    ∑ μ, (X μ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • (Complex.I • (V.map (pderiv μ) * star V)) = P

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.eulerTransport_det
declarations.doc:
A fundamental solution of the radial system `E U = R U` based at the identity has
determinant one when `R` is traceless: by Jacobi's formula the determinant is killed
by the Euler operator, so it is the constant `1`.
declarations.statement:
lemma eulerTransport_det {κ : Type} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    {R U : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra}
    (hjac : ∀ (M : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
      pderiv μ M.det = (M.map (pderiv μ) * M.adjugate).trace)
    (hRtr : R.trace = 0)
    (hU0 : (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* ℂ).mapMatrix U = 1)
    (hEU : ∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • U.map (pderiv ρ) = R * U) :
    U.det = 1

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.matrix_multiset_sum_apply
declarations.doc: The entry of a multiset sum of matrices is the multiset sum of the entries.
declarations.statement:
lemma matrix_multiset_sum_apply {κ α : Type*} [AddCommMonoid α]
    (m : Multiset (Matrix κ κ α)) (i j : κ) :
    m.sum i j = (m.map fun A => A i j).sum

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.matrix_constantCoeff_iteratedPDeriv_mul
declarations.doc:
The matrix Leibniz rule at the base point: the base-point Taylor coefficients of a
product of matrices of jets are the antidiagonal convolution of the base-point
coefficients of the factors.
declarations.statement:
lemma matrix_constantCoeff_iteratedPDeriv_mul {κ : Type} [Fintype κ]
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (M N : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    ((M * N).map fun f => constantCoeff (iteratedPDeriv s f))
      = (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
          (M.map fun f => constantCoeff (iteratedPDeriv p.1 f)) *
            (N.map fun f => constantCoeff (iteratedPDeriv p.2 f))).sum

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.mapMatrix_C_star
declarations.doc: Entrywise inclusion of constants commutes with the conjugate transpose.
declarations.statement:
lemma mapMatrix_C_star [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (A : Matrix κ κ ℂ) :
    (C : ℂ →+* SpaceTimeAlgebra).mapMatrix (star A) = star
        ((C : ℂ →+* SpaceTimeAlgebra).mapMatrix A)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.mapMatrix_C_smul
declarations.doc: Entrywise inclusion of constants commutes with complex scalars.
declarations.statement:
lemma mapMatrix_C_smul [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (c : ℂ) (M : Matrix κ κ ℂ) :
    (C : ℂ →+* SpaceTimeAlgebra).mapMatrix (c • M) = c •
        (C : ℂ →+* SpaceTimeAlgebra).mapMatrix M

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.mapMatrix_constantCoeff_smul
declarations.doc: The entrywise constant coefficient commutes with complex scalars.
declarations.statement:
lemma mapMatrix_constantCoeff_smul [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (c : ℂ)
    (M : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* ℂ).mapMatrix (c • M)
      = c • (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* ℂ).mapMatrix M

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.star_map_pderiv
declarations.doc: The entrywise derivative commutes with the conjugate transpose.
declarations.statement:
lemma star_map_pderiv (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (A : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    star (A.map (pderiv μ)) = (star A).map (pderiv μ)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.map_pderiv_smul
declarations.doc: Pulling a complex scalar out of the entrywise derivative.
declarations.statement:
lemma map_pderiv_smul (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (c : ℂ) (M : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    (c • M).map (pderiv μ) = c • M.map (pderiv μ)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.map_pderiv_sub
declarations.doc: The entrywise derivative of a difference.
declarations.statement:
lemma map_pderiv_sub (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (M N : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    (M - N).map (pderiv μ) = M.map (pderiv μ) - N.map (pderiv μ)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.map_pderiv_star_of_unitary
declarations.doc:
The entrywise derivative of the conjugate transpose of a unitary matrix, through the
differentiated unitarity relation.
declarations.statement:
lemma map_pderiv_star_of_unitary [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    {U : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra}
    (hU : U * star U = 1) (hU' : star U * U = 1) :
    (star U).map (pderiv μ) = -(star U * U.map (pderiv μ) * star U)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.star_mcMatrix
declarations.doc: The Maurer–Cartan matrix `i (∂_μ U) U†` of a unitary matrix of jets is hermitian.
declarations.statement:
lemma star_mcMatrix [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    {U : Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra}
    (hU : U * star U = 1) (hU' : star U * U = 1) :
    star (Complex.I • (U.map (pderiv μ) * star U)) = Complex.I • (U.map (pderiv μ) * star U)

modules.title: Taylor determinacy and completeness of jets
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

A jet is determined by the base-point values of its iterated derivatives, and a jet all of
whose first derivatives vanish is the constant jet of its value. These are the two facts
that make the jets of a matrix gauge group a faithful package of local gauge data, in the
sense of `LocalGaugeData.Faithful`. Conversely every family of base-point Taylor data is
realized by a jet, `ofDerivValues`, and entrywise by a matrix of jets, `taylorMatrix`: this
is the Taylor completeness half of `LocalGaugeData.Free`.

## ii. Key results

- `SpaceTimeAlgebra.ext_of_constantCoeff_iteratedPDeriv` : Taylor determinacy.
- `SpaceTimeAlgebra.eq_C_of_pderiv_eq_zero` : a jet with vanishing derivatives is constant.
- `SpaceTimeAlgebra.ofDerivValues` :
  Taylor completeness.
- `SpaceTimeAlgebra.taylorMatrix` : Taylor completeness for matrices of jets.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. Taylor completeness

## iv. References

* None.

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.star_ofDerivValues
declarations.statement:
lemma star_ofDerivValues (f : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ) :
    star (ofDerivValues f) = ofDerivValues fun s => star (f s)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.ofDerivValues_sum
declarations.statement:
lemma ofDerivValues_sum {ι : Type} (t : Finset ι) (f : ι → Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → ℂ) :
    ofDerivValues (fun s => ∑ i ∈ t, f i s) = ∑ i ∈ t, ofDerivValues (f i)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.taylorMatrix
declarations.doc: The matrix of jets with prescribed base-point Taylor data `M`, entrywise.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def taylorMatrix {κ : Type} (M : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Matrix κ κ ℂ) :
    Matrix κ κ SpaceTimeAlgebra

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.taylorMatrix_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma taylorMatrix_apply {κ : Type} (M : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Matrix κ κ ℂ) (i j : κ) :
    taylorMatrix M i j = ofDerivValues fun s => M s i j

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.star_taylorMatrix
declarations.statement:
lemma star_taylorMatrix {κ : Type} {M : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Matrix κ κ ℂ}
    (hM : ∀ s, star (M s) = M s) : star (taylorMatrix M) = taylorMatrix M

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.trace_taylorMatrix
declarations.statement:
lemma trace_taylorMatrix {κ : Type} [Fintype κ] {M : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Matrix κ κ ℂ}
    (hM : ∀ s, (M s).trace = 0) : (taylorMatrix M).trace = 0

declarations.name: SpaceTimeAlgebra.map_constantCoeff_iteratedPDeriv_taylorMatrix
declarations.doc: The base-point Taylor data of `taylorMatrix M` are `M`, entrywise.

- `SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ` : the ℂ-algebra of derivative symbols in spacetime

- `basis_apply_symmetricAlgebra` : the basis vector at a multiset of derivative indices is the
  monomial of the symmetric algebra of dual symbols
- `basis_nil` : the basis vector at the empty multiset is the unit of the algebra: the zeroth-order
  symbol carries no derivatives

### A.7. The derivative-degree polynomial

The degree scaling of the previous section records the derivative degree in a scalar. The
same construction with the scalar replaced by a formal variable records it in a polynomial:
`gradePoly` is the linear map sending the basis monomial `∂_s` to `X ^ |s| ∂_s`, so the

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis_apply_symmetricAlgebra
declarations.doc:
The basis vector at a multiset of derivative indices is the corresponding basis monomial
of the symmetric algebra of dual symbols. This is `basis_apply` of
`Physlib.SpaceAndTime.SpaceTime.SpaceTimeDerivAlgebra.Basic` in the symmetric-algebra form,
rather than through `SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial`.
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_apply_symmetricAlgebra (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    basis s =
      Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis.dualBasis.symmetricAlgebra (Multiset.toFinsupp s)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.basis_nil
declarations.doc:
The basis vector at the empty multiset is the unit of the algebra: the
zeroth-order symbol carries no derivatives.
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_nil :
    basis ({} : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) = 1

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.deriv
declarations.doc:
The derivative of an element in `SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ` taking e.g.
`∂_s` to `∂_μ ∂_s`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def deriv (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ →ₗ[ℂ] SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.deriv_basis
declarations.statement:
lemma deriv_basis (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (m : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ) :
    deriv μ (Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis.dualBasis.symmetricAlgebra m) =
      Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis.dualBasis.symmetricAlgebra (m + Finsupp.single μ 1)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.deriv_comm_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma deriv_comm_apply (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) :
    deriv μ (deriv ν x) = deriv ν (deriv μ x)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.deriv_basis_multiset
declarations.doc:
The derivative operator on the multiset basis: appending the derivative
index to the multiset.
declarations.statement:
lemma deriv_basis_multiset (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    deriv μ (basis s) = basis (s + {μ})

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.deriv_apply_eq_mul
declarations.doc:
The derivative operator is right multiplication by the first-order derivative
symbol.
declarations.statement:
lemma deriv_apply_eq_mul (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) :
    deriv μ a = a * basis ({μ} : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))

declarations.name: MvPowerSeries.pderiv_comm
declarations.doc:
Formal partial derivatives of a multivariate power series commute: each is given on
coefficients by a shift and a multiplication, and the two shifts commute.
declarations.statement:
lemma _root_.MvPowerSeries.pderiv_comm {σ R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (i j : σ)
    (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    MvPowerSeries.pderiv i (MvPowerSeries.pderiv j f) =
      MvPowerSeries.pderiv j (MvPowerSeries.pderiv i f)

declarations.doc:
Differentiating a jet along a multiset of directions is well defined: the partial
derivatives commute, so the fold over a multiset does not depend on the order.
declarations.statement:
instance : RightCommutative
    (fun (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) => MvPowerSeries.pderiv μ f)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.eval
declarations.doc: The evaluation map taking a function `f : SpaceTimeAlgebra` to `∂_μ f`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def eval : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ →ₗ[ℂ] SpaceTimeAlgebra →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.eval_basis
declarations.statement:
lemma eval_basis (m : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    eval (Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis.dualBasis.symmetricAlgebra m) f =
      (∏ μ, (m μ)! : ℕ) • MvPowerSeries.coeff m f

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.eval_monomial
declarations.statement:
lemma eval_monomial (p : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) (m : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ) :
    eval p (MvPowerSeries.monomial m 1) =
      ((∏ μ, (m μ)! : ℕ) : ℂ) *
        Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis.dualBasis.symmetricAlgebra.repr p m

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.eval_injective
declarations.statement:
lemma eval_injective {p q : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ}
    (h : ∀ f, eval p f = eval q f) : p = q

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.eval_deriv
declarations.doc:
Adjointness: the shift of derivative symbols is the transpose of the formal
partial derivative under the divided-power pairing.
declarations.statement:
lemma eval_deriv (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (p : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    eval (deriv ν p) f = eval p (MvPowerSeries.pderiv ν f)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.eval_one
declarations.doc:
The pairing of the unit derivative symbol with a jet is its value at the base
point: the empty derivative multiset reads off the constant term.
declarations.statement:
lemma eval_one (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    eval (1 : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) f = MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff f

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.eval_basis_eq_constantCoeff_iteratedPDeriv
declarations.doc:
Iterating adjointness: the pairing of the basis monomial `∂_s` with a jet is the
constant term of the iterated formal partial derivative `∂_s f`. This is the concrete
description of the divided-power pairing that `eval_deriv` encodes one derivative at a
time.
declarations.statement:
lemma eval_basis_eq_constantCoeff_iteratedPDeriv (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    eval (basis s) f =
      MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv s f)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingAction
declarations.doc:
The action of `χ` on the derivatives, this takes `∂_μ ·` to `∂_μ (χ ·)`,
expanded out explicitly.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def jetRingAction (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ →ₗ[ℂ] SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingAction_basis
declarations.statement:
lemma jetRingAction_basis (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (m : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) →₀ ℕ) :
    jetRingAction χ (Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis.dualBasis.symmetricAlgebra m) =
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m,
        ((∏ μ, (m μ).descFactorial (p.1 μ) : ℕ) : ℂ) • MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 χ •
          Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis.dualBasis.symmetricAlgebra p.2

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.eval_jetRingAction
declarations.statement:
lemma eval_jetRingAction (χ f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (p : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) :
    eval (jetRingAction χ p) f = eval p (χ * f)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingAction_basis_multiset
declarations.doc:
The action of a jet on a derivative monomial, in multiset form: `∂_s` is sent to the
all-orders Leibniz convolution, each splitting `s = s₁ + s₂` of the derivative multiset
contributing the base-point Taylor coefficient `(∂_{s₁} χ)(0)` against the lower monomial
`∂_{s₂}`.

This is `jetRingAction_basis` with the `Nat.choose` bookkeeping traded for the
divided-power pairing: both sides are compared through `eval`, where the identity is the
Leibniz rule `SpaceTimeAlgebra.constantCoeff_iteratedPDeriv_mul` at the base point. It is the form
in which the transformation law of a matter field is stated.
declarations.statement:
lemma jetRingAction_basis_multiset (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    jetRingAction χ (basis s) =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff
            (SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv p.1 χ) • basis p.2).sum

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingAction_C
declarations.doc:
Constant jets act on the derivative symbols by their value: `C c` has no
derivative coordinates.
declarations.statement:
lemma jetRingAction_C (c : ℂ) :
    jetRingAction (MvPowerSeries.C c) = c • LinearMap.id

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingAction_one
declarations.statement: lemma jetRingAction_one : jetRingAction (1 : SpaceTimeAlgebra) = LinearMap.id

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingAction_mul
declarations.doc:
The derivative action is multiplicative: it is the transpose of multiplication
in the commutative jet ring. This makes `χ ↦ χ(∂)` a monoid homomorphism and
hence yields representations of the jet gauge group on polynomial jet spaces.
declarations.statement:
lemma jetRingAction_mul (χ ψ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    jetRingAction (χ * ψ) = jetRingAction χ ∘ₗ jetRingAction ψ

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingAction_zero
declarations.statement: lemma jetRingAction_zero : jetRingAction (0 : SpaceTimeAlgebra) = 0

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingAction_add
declarations.statement:
lemma jetRingAction_add (χ ψ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    jetRingAction (χ + ψ) = jetRingAction χ + jetRingAction ψ

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingActionHom
declarations.doc:
The derivative action as a ring homomorphism from the jet ring to the
endomorphisms of the algebra of derivative symbols: the module structure of the
jet ring on its graded dual.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def jetRingActionHom : SpaceTimeAlgebra →+* Module.End ℂ SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingAction_comm
declarations.doc: The actions of two jets commute: the jet ring is commutative.
declarations.statement:
lemma jetRingAction_comm (χ ψ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) :
    jetRingAction χ (jetRingAction ψ a) = jetRingAction ψ (jetRingAction χ a)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingAction_apply_one
declarations.doc:
The derivative action on the zeroth-order (field) symbol: it is scaled by the
value of the jet at the base point.
declarations.statement:
lemma jetRingAction_apply_one (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) :
    jetRingAction χ (1 : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) =
      MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff χ • 1

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingAction_apply_ι
declarations.doc:
The derivative action on a first-order derivative symbol implements the Leibniz
rule: `∂_μ ↦ χ(0) ∂_μ + (∂_μχ)(0) 1`. The value of the jet multiplies the
first-derivative symbol, and its first derivative feeds the zeroth-order
symbol.
declarations.statement:
lemma jetRingAction_apply_ι (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    jetRingAction χ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ (Module.Dual ℂ Lorentz.ComplexCoVector)
        (Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis.dualBasis μ)) =
      MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff χ •
        SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ (Module.Dual ℂ Lorentz.ComplexCoVector)
          (Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis.dualBasis μ) +
        MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single μ 1) χ • 1

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingAction_deriv
declarations.doc:
The commutation of the jet-ring action with the derivative operator: acting by
`χ` after differentiating equals differentiating after acting, plus the action
of the derivative `∂_ν χ`. This is the operator form of the Leibniz rule
`∂_ν (χ f) = χ ∂_ν f + (∂_ν χ) f` under the divided-power pairing.
declarations.statement:
lemma jetRingAction_deriv (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) :
    jetRingAction χ (deriv ν a) =
      deriv ν (jetRingAction χ a) + jetRingAction (MvPowerSeries.pderiv ν χ) a

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.repLorentzGroup
declarations.doc:
The representation of the Lorentz group `SL(2,ℂ)` on the algebra of derivative
symbols, extending the dual covector representation multiplicatively.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def repLorentzGroup : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.repLorentzGroup_apply_one
declarations.statement: lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_one (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) : repLorentzGroup Λ 1 = 1

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.repLorentzGroup_apply_mul
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_mul (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (a b : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (a * b) = repLorentzGroup Λ a * repLorentzGroup Λ b

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.repLorentzGroup_apply_ι
declarations.doc: The Lorentz action on a generator.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_ι (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (x : Module.Dual ℂ Lorentz.ComplexCoVector) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ (Module.Dual ℂ Lorentz.ComplexCoVector) x) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ (Module.Dual ℂ Lorentz.ComplexCoVector)
        (Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.SL2CRep.dual Λ x)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.repLorentzGroup_deriv
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz action on a derivative: the derivative symbol transforms as a
covector, mixing the spacetime directions by the components of `Λ` in the dual
covector representation.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_deriv (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (deriv μ a) =
      ∑ ν, (Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.SL2CRep.dual Λ (Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis.dualBasis μ))
        (Lorentz.ComplexCoVector.basis ν) • deriv ν (repLorentzGroup Λ a)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.repLorentzGroup_basis_singleton
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz action on the singleton derivative monomial: the derivative
slot transforms by the columns of the Lorentz matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_basis_singleton (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (basis ({μ} : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))) =
      ∑ ν, (((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 ν μ : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        basis ({ν} : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.repLorentzGroup_basis_ofFn
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz action on the derivative monomial of an ordered tuple of directions: every
slot mixes by the columns of the Lorentz matrix, one factor per slot.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_basis_ofFn (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (basis (List.ofFn l)) =
      ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3),
        (∏ i, (((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 (p i) (l i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • basis (List.ofFn p)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.gradeScale
declarations.doc:
The derivative-degree scaling on the algebra of derivative symbols: the
algebra map multiplying each generator by `t`, hence each degree-`n` monomial
by `t ^ n`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def gradeScale (t : ℂ) : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ →ₐ[ℂ] SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.gradeScale_ι
declarations.statement:
lemma gradeScale_ι (t : ℂ) (x : Module.Dual ℂ Lorentz.ComplexCoVector) :
    gradeScale t (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ (Module.Dual ℂ Lorentz.ComplexCoVector) x) =
      t • SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ (Module.Dual ℂ Lorentz.ComplexCoVector) x

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.gradeScale_basis
declarations.doc: The degree scaling multiplies the basis monomial at `s` by `t ^ |s|`.
declarations.statement:
lemma gradeScale_basis (t : ℂ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    gradeScale t (basis s) = t ^ s.card • basis s

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.gradeScale_repLorentzGroup
declarations.doc:
The degree scaling commutes with the Lorentz action: the Lorentz action
preserves the derivative degree.
declarations.statement:
lemma gradeScale_repLorentzGroup (t : ℂ) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) :
    gradeScale t (repLorentzGroup Λ a) = repLorentzGroup Λ (gradeScale t a)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.gradePoly
declarations.doc:
The derivative-degree polynomial on the algebra of derivative symbols: the linear map
sending the basis monomial `∂_s` to `X ^ |s|` times itself. It is `gradeScale` with the
scalar replaced by the formal variable `X`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def gradePoly : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ →ₗ[ℂ] Polynomial SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.gradePoly_basis
declarations.doc: The derivative-degree polynomial of a basis monomial is the monomial of degree `|s|`.
declarations.statement:
lemma gradePoly_basis (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    gradePoly (basis s) = Polynomial.monomial (Multiset.card s) (basis s)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.eval_algebraMap_gradePoly
declarations.doc:
Evaluating the derivative-degree polynomial at a scalar is the derivative-degree
scaling by that scalar: the two descriptions of the grading agree.
declarations.statement:
lemma eval_algebraMap_gradePoly (t : ℂ) (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) :
    (gradePoly a).eval (algebraMap ℂ SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ t) = gradeScale t a

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.gradePoly_eval_one
declarations.doc:
Setting the formal variable to one recovers the original element: the pieces of a
graded decomposition sum to the element.
declarations.statement: lemma gradePoly_eval_one (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ) : (gradePoly a).eval 1 = a

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ
declarations.doc: The ℝ-algebra of derivative symbols in spacetime.
declarations.statement: abbrev SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.repLorentzGroup
declarations.doc:
The representation of the Lorentz group `SL(2,ℂ)` on the algebra of derivative
symbols, extending the dual covector representation multiplicatively.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def repLorentzGroup : Representation ℝ SL(2,ℂ) SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.repLorentzGroup_apply_ι
declarations.doc: The Lorentz action on a generator of the real derivative algebra.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_ι (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (x : Module.Dual ℝ Lorentz.CoVector) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ (Module.Dual ℝ Lorentz.CoVector) x) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ (Module.Dual ℝ Lorentz.CoVector)
        (Lorentz.CoVector.sl2Rep.dual Λ x)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.repLorentzGroup_apply_mul
declarations.doc:
The real derivative-algebra representation is multiplicative: it is the lift of a linear
map to the symmetric algebra.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_mul (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (a b : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ) :
    SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.repLorentzGroup Λ (a * b) =
      SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.repLorentzGroup Λ a * SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.repLorentzGroup Λ b

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.repLorentzGroup_apply_one
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_one (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.repLorentzGroup Λ 1 = 1

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.gradeScale
declarations.doc:
The derivative-degree scaling on the real algebra of derivative symbols:
the algebra map multiplying each generator by `t`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def gradeScale (t : ℝ) : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ →ₐ[ℝ] SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.gradeScale_ι
declarations.statement:
lemma gradeScale_ι (t : ℝ) (x : Module.Dual ℝ Lorentz.CoVector) :
    gradeScale t (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ (Module.Dual ℝ Lorentz.CoVector) x) =
      t • SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ (Module.Dual ℝ Lorentz.CoVector) x

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.gradeScale_repLorentzGroup
declarations.doc:
The degree scaling commutes with the Lorentz action on the real derivative
symbols.
declarations.statement:
lemma gradeScale_repLorentzGroup (t : ℝ) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ) :
    gradeScale t (repLorentzGroup Λ a) = repLorentzGroup Λ (gradeScale t a)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset
declarations.doc:
The basis of the symmetric algebra of dual real jet slots, indexed by multisets of
spacetime indices.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def basisMultiset :
    Basis (Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) ℝ (SymmetricAlgebra ℝ (Module.Dual ℝ Lorentz.CoVector))

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset_apply
declarations.doc:
The multiset basis of the dual derivative symbols, as a basis vector of the
symmetric algebra at the corresponding multi-index.
declarations.statement:
lemma basisMultiset_apply (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    basisMultiset s =
      Lorentz.CoVector.basis.dualBasis.symmetricAlgebra (Multiset.toFinsupp s)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset_mul
declarations.doc:
The multiset basis vectors of the real dual derivative slots multiply by adding the
multisets.
declarations.statement:
lemma basisMultiset_mul (s t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    basisMultiset s * basisMultiset t =
      basisMultiset (s + t)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset_nil
declarations.doc:
The multiset basis of the real dual derivative slots at the empty multiset is the
unit.
declarations.statement:
lemma basisMultiset_nil :
    basisMultiset (0 : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) = 1

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset_singleton
declarations.doc: The multiset basis of the real dual derivative slots at a singleton index.
declarations.statement:
lemma basisMultiset_singleton (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    basisMultiset ({μ} : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ (Module.Dual ℝ Lorentz.CoVector)
        (Lorentz.CoVector.basis.dualBasis μ)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.gradeScale_basisMultiset
declarations.doc: The degree scaling multiplies the real basis monomial at `s` by `t ^ |s|`.
declarations.statement:
lemma gradeScale_basisMultiset (t : ℝ) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    gradeScale t (basisMultiset s) = t ^ Multiset.card s • basisMultiset s

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.gradePoly
declarations.doc:
The derivative-degree polynomial on the real algebra of derivative symbols: the linear
map sending the basis monomial `∂_s` to `X ^ |s|` times itself.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def gradePoly : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ →ₗ[ℝ] Polynomial SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.gradePoly_basisMultiset
declarations.doc:
The derivative-degree polynomial of a real basis monomial is the monomial of degree
`|s|`.
declarations.statement:
lemma gradePoly_basisMultiset (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    gradePoly (basisMultiset s) =
      Polynomial.monomial (Multiset.card s) (basisMultiset s)

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.eval_algebraMap_gradePoly
declarations.doc:
Evaluating the real derivative-degree polynomial at a scalar is the derivative-degree
scaling by that scalar.
declarations.statement:
lemma eval_algebraMap_gradePoly (t : ℝ) (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ) :
    (gradePoly a).eval (algebraMap ℝ SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ t) = gradeScale t a

declarations.name: SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.gradePoly_eval_one
declarations.doc:
Setting the formal variable to one recovers the original element of the real
derivative algebra.
declarations.statement: lemma gradePoly_eval_one (a : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ) : (gradePoly a).eval 1 = a
